exposure: Quantra parameters (Fibrinogen contribution to Clot Stiffness - FCS)
Mode of delivery (elective cesarean delivery vs. labor)
outcome: Correlation between Quantra parameters and standard laboratory coagulation tests
cohort: Healthy term pregnant women (n=170) who were either in labor or scheduled for elective cesarean delivery.
finding: There was a strong correlation between Quantra Fibrinogen contribution to Clot Stiffness (FCS) and standard laboratory fibrinogen levels (r = 0.67), and Quantra provided fibrinogen results significantly faster than standard laboratory tests.
mod_finding: Baseline Quantra values were not significantly different between the cesarean delivery and labor groups.
cross-section timing: During labor or prior to elective cesarean delivery
